characters.summary: Dry Bowser is the skeletal, undead form of Bowser who retains his fire-breathing capabilities and gains skeletal resilience and bone-throwing attacks.

mechanisms: Undead skeletal anatomy immune to standard blunt force

weaknesses: Vulnerability to lava or being dropped into deep pits
Reconstitution can be interrupted or destroyed by complete incineration
limitations: Skeletal structure can still collapse temporarily upon heavy impact
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Bowser into a skeletal undead version with immunity to standard damage and the ability to throw bones and breathe blue fire.

sources.supports: General overview of Bowser forms including Dry Bowser.

feats.claim: Survived being boiled in magma and returned as a skeleton.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Mario triggered the bridge switch beneath him.

conditional.dependsOn: Falling into lava or taking fatal damage in base form

campaignTags.claim: Breathes blue or standard hellfire.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how Bowser transitions into Dry Bowser outside of severe magma injury.

characters.summary: Fury Bowser is a gigantic, corrupted, kaiju-sized version of Bowser who rains down fiery projectiles and attacks with overwhelming mass.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to the light of the Giga Bell
mobility: Swimming in lava and water at giant scale
limitations: Becomes dormant for periods before rampaging again
characters.formDifferences: Magnifies Bowser to kaiju proportions, covering him in spikes, dark shell plates, and glowing fiery patterns.

sources.supports: Information regarding Bowser's appearance and Fury Bowser form in Bowser's Fury.

feats.claim: Awakened periodically from sleep to reshape Lake Lapcat and terrorize the environment.

conditional.dependsOn: Exposure to the black paint or dark fury energy

campaignTags.claim: Grows to massive kaiju proportions.
Fires massive beams of destructive fire.

unknowns: The absolute limit of durability against non-Giga Bell attacks.

characters.summary: Giga Bowser is a monstrous, towering transformation of Bowser characterized by extreme physical strength, glowing eyes, and demonic horns.

mechanisms: Immunity to flinching from standard attacks

characters.formDifferences: Transforms Bowser into a gigantic, horned demon-like beast with overwhelming physical power and knockback resistance.

sources.supports: Introduction of Giga Bowser as a boss character.

feats.claim: Fought off multiple Smash fighters simultaneously as a boss.
feats.citation: Super Smash Bros. Melee / Super Smash Bros. Ultimate

notableResults.citation: Super Smash Bros. Melee Adventure Mode
notableResults.note: Defeated by players in solo matches.

conditional.dependsOn: Accessing Final Smash or appearing as an event boss

campaignTags.claim: Grows into a towering monster form.
Unleashes massive torrents of fire.

unknowns: Canon scaling outside of the Smash tournament universe framework.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to water and electric attacks
limitations: Obedience depends on Trainer's badge count or bond in early training

feats.claim: Melted massive boulders and steel structures with fiery breath.

campaignTags.claim: Flies using large built-in wings.
Generates and controls intense fire streams.

characters.summary: Chell is a silent test subject who navigates lethal environments using the Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device and spatial momentum.

mechanisms: Long Fall Boots preventing impact damage

weaknesses: Physically ordinary human with no superhuman durability or hand-to-hand combat training
limitations: Cannot place portals on non-conductive surfaces like wood, metal grids, or open terrain

sources.supports: Overview of Chell, her equipment, and Portal mechanics.

feats.claim: Escaped the collapsing Aperture Science facility and defeated GLaDOS and Wheatley.

notableResults.note: Destroyed personality cores while evading neurotoxin.

conditional.dependsOn: Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device and flat white surfaces

campaignTags.claim: Wields the Portal Gun to create teleportation gateways.
Equipped with Long Fall Boots and Portal Gun.

unknowns: What happened to Chell following her release into the wheat field at the end of Portal 2.
